question: Find out how many actors have a 'Shahrukh number' of 2? This means they acted in a film with someone who acted with Shahrukh Khan, but not directly with him.
sql:
WITH srk_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(mc.MID) AS mid FROM M_Cast mc WHERE TRIM(mc.PID) = 'nm0451321'
),
srk_coactors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID) AS PID
    FROM M_Cast mc
    WHERE mc.MID IN (SELECT mid FROM srk_movies)
    AND TRIM(mc.PID) != 'nm0451321'
),
coactor_movies_excluding_srk AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(mc.MID) AS MID
    FROM M_Cast mc
    WHERE TRIM(mc.PID) IN (SELECT PID FROM srk_coactors)
    AND TRIM(mc.MID) NOT IN (SELECT mid FROM srk_movies)
),
shahrukh2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID) AS PID
    FROM M_Cast mc
    WHERE mc.MID IN (SELECT MID FROM coactor_movies_excluding_srk)
    AND TRIM(mc.PID) != 'nm0451321'
    AND TRIM(mc.PID) NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM srk_coactors)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_of_actors_with_shahrukh_number_2
FROM shahrukh2
